name: Concordia University — Sir George Williams campus

landmarks.name: Maison-Mère des Sœurs grises
facts: It is the former motherhouse of the Grey Nuns, now a residence and reading room.
It was built for the Grey Nuns in the 1870s to a design by Victor Bourgeau; the university acquired it in 2007.

landmarks.name: H - Henry F. Hall Building
facts: It is named after a president of Sir George Williams University from 1956 to 1962.
It was the scene of the Sir George Williams computer riot in 1969.

landmarks.name: LB - J. W. McConnell Building (Library Building)
facts: It is home to the Webster Library.

landmarks.name: EV - Engineering, Computer Science and Visual Arts Integrated Complex
facts: It opened in 2005 and joins two faculties under one roof, with art studios and labs.

landmarks.name: MB - John Molson School of Business
facts: It opened in 2009 beside Guy-Concordia metro station.
